rules: If mapping.idField is supplied: use properties[mapping.idField]; otherwise use feature.id
Missing/null/empty ID is refused; booleans and non-string/non-number IDs are refused
Convert with Python str, then _text: nonempty text <=256 characters, strip end whitespace

recipe: ingestArea passes input.mapping to the Python area normalize operation
Manual recipe compileMapping selects mapping.idField from its building.sourceKey operation
NYC catalogue adapter chooses doitt_id; this is a recipe, not a universal key function
